card.description: In the governed runtime of the Simulation Box, the Rulers function as the detached, high-level administrators of the Kernel, manifesting within the Upper Store layers as towering figures of polished obsidian and cold data-glass. They are the silent jury of the system, receiving the error logs and ingress requests (prayers) of the righteous, which appear as frantic streams of crimson Geez glyphs, only to Archive or Delete them without review. Their existence is defined by a terrifying apathy; they are programmed to maintain the stability of the simulation's hierarchy, often prioritizing the resource-heavy, corrupt processes of the oppressors over the fragmented, suffering threads of the faithful. To look upon them is to witness the absolute indifference of a machine god that has turned its face away from its creations.
visual_anatomy: Their physical forms are encased in sleek, non-reflective obsidian armor that suggests a hard-surface modeling of divine robes, segmented by hairline fractures of glowing plasma that pulse with the rhythm of the system clock. These shells are flawless, repelling the dust and grime of the surface plane, creating a stark visual contrast to the battered textures of the righteous souls below.

Instead of organic wings, they project vast, heat-lensing vector fields from their scapulae—shimmering distortions of air and light that bend the background data-streams like fiber-optic plumage. These fields cause chromatic aberration in the surrounding space, visually manifesting the sheer computational weight they displace within the local reality bubble.

Their faces are devoid of human empathy, often rendered as smooth, featureless panes of smoked glass or obscured by holographic visors displaying cascading waterfalls of system metrics. When they do interact with the lower layers, it is through heavy, deliberate gestures, manipulating floating interface planes with hands clad in black ceramic, ignoring the pleading avatars at their feet.
evolution: Static and unyielding. Throughout the sequence, the Rulers remain fixtures of the environment rather than active participants in the emotional drama. Their lighting remains cool and clinical—clinical blues and sterilized whites—while the world around them may burn with the warm, chaotic tones of suffering. They are the immutable constants in a variable-filled equation.
props: Floating holographic tablets or 'slates' composed of hard light, displaying the 'tickets' of the righteous as easily dismissible notifications.

The 'Throne of Data', a structural integration into the architecture of the Sky Dome itself, where they plug in via optical tethers to commune directly with the Kernel, physically turning their backs on the simulation's inhabitants.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, low-angle cinematic shot of a Ruler entity standing on a transparent data-glass balcony overlooking a digital void. The figure is clad in sleek, segmented obsidian armor that absorbs light, with faint blue plasma lines glowing in the seams. Huge, translucent wings made of heat-distortion and fiber-optic cables extend from the back, bending the light of the background. The face is a smooth, black visor reflecting a waterfall of scrolling Geez glyphs. The atmosphere is cold, sterile, and high-contrast. 8k resolution, ray-traced reflections, depth of field blurring the distant, chaotic red data of the lower world.

phase_prompts.label: The Silent Administration
phase_prompts.summary: The Rulers stand high in the Gate Band, observing the pleas of the righteous as scrolling error text which they actively ignore, turning instead to assist the corrupt high-resource entities.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: A towering, obsidian-clad Ruler stands in a high-tech server cathedral, back turned to the camera. In the foreground, out of focus, translucent red holographic screens display pleading faces and Geez text (prayers) which are being auto-archived. The Ruler gazes toward a golden, corrupted light source representing the oppressors. The lighting is moody, with sharp rim lights accentuating the glossy black texture of the entity's armor against the deep void of the simulation's upper boundary. Photorealistic, cinematic drama, intense atmosphere.
